method: Headless Chromium on macOS, software rendering. Compare ten unchanged panel updates with the same ten updates after invalidating only the canvas cache.
result: Zero drawImage calls with caching versus thirty without, in all three viewport/DPI cases. Original canvas output is separately compared to source HFX and native draw commands.
limits: Operation-count comparison, not hardware FPS certification. The canvas follows interpolated unit positions each render; panel lifetime uses the existing elapsed 24 Hz presentation adapter.
controlsRegression: Rechecked after adding order buttons: same ten-update operation counts and geometry. Native sprite submissions also supply button bounds; existing buttons are reused. Right-click/keyboard destination focus, hover/focus retention, immediate targets, modal/stale guards and exact queue/selection preservation pass at each listed viewport.
